desc:
🩸 A ragdoll sandbox where every hit is real.

Dummies react exactly where you hit them. Shoot a leg and they limp, hit an arm and they clutch it, cut them in half and they bleed out.

💥 REAL PHYSICS
• Dummies stagger, crawl, get back up and run from you
• Limbs come off, wounds bleed, bones break
• Others drag the wounded away and patch them up

🔫 25+ WEAPONS
• Pistols, SMGs, shotguns, rifles and snipers with suppressors, lasers and scopes
• Katana, fire axe, sledgehammer, grenades, grapple and rope gun
• Telekinesis: lift anything and throw it

🔥 POWERS
• Laser Eyes: burn and slice what you look at
• Cleave: swipe across anything to cut it in two

🚗 CHAOS
• Drive cars, slice them in half or blow them up
• Explosive barrels, boulders, a wrecking ball, breakable walls
• Slow motion for the perfect hit

🎬 Replay editor and photo mode
📅 Daily challenges and weapon mastery
📱 PC and mobile
